answer_2.quote: We consider a range of state-of-the-art text generation metrics (TGMs), such as BERTScore , MoverScore  and BLEURT , which we repurpose for evaluating thematic coherence in microblogs and correlate them with assessments of coherence by journalist experts.

answer_4.quote: Coherence annotation was carried out in four stages by three annotators. We chose experienced journalists as they are trained to quickly and reliably identify salient content.
answer_4.guideline: Cluster Annotation: What was your opinion about the cluster? (a) Choose 'Good' if you can identify one subject within the cluster to which most tweets refer... (b) Choose 'Intermediate' if you are uncertain that the cluster is good... (c) Choose 'Bad' if you are certain that the cluster is not good...
